respaldo: Drawn arrow from User to CloudFront; transcript: 'Al Musafir receives on an average around 300k requests per minute. This traffic goes through CloudFront.'

Drawn line between CloudFront and S3; transcript: 'utilizing a very effective and cost efficient storage place like S3 to serve our content, to serve our images'

Drawn curved line from Load Balancer to EC2; transcript: 'migrating from legacy systems that still hosted in EC2'
